messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Eighth protocol. Its genome reconfigures in waves. Every choice stabilizes one area and makes another more unstable.

choices.label: I lock its current form before a dangerous mutation.
I simulate possible mutations before intervening.
I let it adapt to the test environment.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Every correction also removes a possibility. The more we seek a perfect form, the more it loses something unpredictable.

choices.label: I prioritize a robust defensive anatomy.
I balance the parameters instead of maximizing one quality.
I preserve the anomalies that give it new options.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: The perfect creature may be the wrong phrase. Tell me which flaw you accept leaving in it.

choices.label: It will be too protective, but able to endure.
It will be too curious, but able to learn.
It will be too bonded to me, but able to feel.
